description: Implementation of the Simulator class for vehicle hardware interface, including property management, simulation routines, and interaction with vehicle properties.

classes.name: Simulator
classes.description: A class that simulates vehicle properties and behaviors for testing or development purposes.

methods.name: Simulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing vehicle property counters and starting the routine thread.

methods.name: getAllPropertyConfig
methods.description: Returns an empty list of vehicle property configurations.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a vehicle property value and updates its status if supported.

methods.name: routine
methods.description: Main loop that periodically simulates property updates until requested to stop.

methods.name: setIfSupportedProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property is supported and sets it accordingly.

methods.name: setVendorTestSysProp
methods.description: Attempts to set a system property, but always returns access denied.

methods.name: simulateVendorTestSysProp
methods.description: Checks and updates a system property value.
